- Indie dev team (founder + 4 contractors). Bootstrapped. Small POC for an in-app code assistant and contextual chat.

- "Mostly interested in predictable per-token costs and low-latency for <200ms tail" — founder (paraphrase).
- Prototype uses embeddings for doc search (user docs + code snippets) and a chat assistant with code synth.
- Primary constraints: cost sensitivity, easy SDK integration (Node), and clear quota limits.
- Wants basic examples for streaming + function/tool calling patterns.

- Model preference: open/quantized weights if cheaper, but will accept Redwood-curated small-to-medium models. No strict vendor lock requirement.
- Routing/fallback: wants automatic fallback to lower-cost model on spikes; not critical in MVP but would be nice.
- Security/compliance: basic SOC2 expectations; SSO not required now; retention controls nice-to-have.

- 2026-03-01: self-serve signup, created project, generated API key.
- 2026-03-02: ran quick embeddings smoke test; reported slightly higher latency than expected. Logged RLINF-3124.

- 2026-03-08: emailed docs on SDK snippets + cost estimator (gmail thread:1659034f_argon-onboarding).
- 2026-03-12: small production test started (50 queries/day).

Quotes / founder lines:
- "We're prototyping a lightweight coder assistant inside our editor—cost is everything right now."
- "If we can keep the monthly bill predictable and have clear SDK examples we'll be happy to stay self-serve."

POC / success criteria:
- Embedding recall > 0.78 on internal set.
- P95 chat latency < 300ms on hosted API for typical prompts.
- Monthly cost under $150 for initial beta.
